howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools pulls out the images
howto.text: Each embedded raster image is saved at the pixel size stored in the PDF. JPEG and JPEG 2000 images keep their format; others are saved as PNG. Vector drawings are not images and are not extracted, and images stored inline in the page content are skipped.

howto.name: Download as ZIP
howto.text: All extracted images are bundled into a ZIP archive, named by page and order.

faq.q: Will the images be the original resolution?
faq.a: Yes. Each image is saved at the pixel size stored in the PDF, without resampling. RGB and greyscale JPEGs are copied byte for byte, CMYK JPEGs are re-saved as high-quality JPEG, and other images are saved without further quality loss, but a separate transparency mask is not applied, so a logo with a transparent background comes out on a solid one.

faq.q: What if the same image appears multiple times?
faq.a: Each page that uses it gets its own copy in the ZIP, so a logo repeated on every page comes out once per page. Remove the duplicates afterwards if you need to.

faq.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faq.a: Yes — each page of a scanned PDF is one big image. The tool extracts that page-image directly.
